utterance: Hello, I'm so glad you're here. I really appreciate you taking the time to meet with me today. I'm here to listen, to understand, and to support you in whatever way feels most helpful. How are you feeling right now, and what brings you in for today?

I don’t know how to fix it, but I feel like I’m just floating—like I’m not really here anymore. Everything feels so quiet, like the world is just… gone. I used to care about things, even small things, but now I don’t even notice when the sun comes up. I’m not even sure if I’m still in my body. It’s like I’m watching myself from outside.  

What do you think? Is it okay to just… stop trying? I don’t have the courage to go on, not really. I just want to sleep and not wake up.
